active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: 684a shows stronger normalized-innovation conditional margins are not sufficient and can be actively misaligned with deployable scenario quality. Nearest-history hard negatives improve the margin diagnostic and validation objective, but damage IV level KS, median allocation, cointegration, and distributional fidelity. The bottleneck is objective alignment with integrated level/path law, not simply conditional separability.
last_result_summary: 684a added condition_rollout_negative_mode=nearest_history and fine-tuned the 676a joint38 incumbent with the same 682a settings. Best val_total improved to 1.8127 versus 682a's 1.8304, and validation margin rose from 0.00081 to 0.00189. However high-sample IV-facing score regressed from 6/11 to 4/11: coverage90 0.804, calibration 0.071, level KS 12/25, median-bias fraction 19/25, cointegration worst-cell ratio 0.224 fail, distributional fidelity failed, and h7 mean-reversion still failed. Joint panel stayed acceptable with factor delta KS mean 0.100, 11/13 factor KS pass, factor-factor corr 0.791, and IV-factor corr 0.893.
next_step_recommendation: Do not continue by increasing contrast weight or hardness. Keep 682a as the best clean native joint38 checkpoint. Next choose research_ideation or post_experiment_analysis: redesign the conditional objective so it is level/path-law aware, or shift from loss tweaks to conditioning representation/encoder diagnostics. Avoid adding more contrast knobs under the clean-pathology guard.
